title: T9 — Project WBS (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project WBS — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Work packages

| Deliverable | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The TOGAF ADM capability — eleven tables, 26 actions, phase gates, contracts and compliance | 13 | 8 | 13 | 13 | accepted |

WSJF = (13+8+13)/13 = 2.615, computed from the four integers and never stored (§8.2). The
risk-reduction input is the highest because the gates and waivers are the programme's control
surface; the size is large at eleven tables and 26 actions.

## Acceptance

The §12 T9 gate, clause by clause, proved at review scope by the named real-Postgres tests in
the Phase-G review: `togaf_architecture_phases.rs::phases_a_to_f_pass_in_order` and its refusal
cases; `togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs`; `architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`;
`togaf_h_change.rs::a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row` and
`an_unrecorded_review_refuses_the_gate`. The deviations this batch admits are named in the
review (v1-p81-4, v1-p81-5, v1-p81-6 and the rest of T9's open findings), not waived.

## Status

Accepted as the retrospective WBS deliverable; six P1/P2 findings remain open against T9 and
are carried as work. The project's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T9.toml`.
